description: React component for managing allowed domains in a chatbot configuration, including UI for inputting domains, error messages, and saving configuration via API.

classes.name: AllowedDomains
classes.description: React functional component for editing allowed domain list and error message in chatbot configuration.

methods.name: addInputField
methods.description: Adds a new empty domain input field.

methods.name: removeInputFields
methods.description: Removes a domain input field at specified index.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change in domain input fields.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current allowed domains and error message to backend API and updates state.
